title: Hame Kehti Hai Duniya Wafadarane Ghazi
body:
Hame kehti hai duniya wafadaran-e-ghazi
Yehi kmatam musalsal ibadath hai hamari
Karam Abbas ka hai
Bharam Abbas ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Alam Abbas ka hai
Badi pehchan apni
Udaao khaak udaao
Lahu apna bhaao
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaza Abbas denge
Hame qhuwwat milegi
Hai moomeen ki alamath
Ye matam shah ki nusrath
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye majlis ka saliqa
Aata binte nabi ki
Bahate hai ham aansu
Gham-e-karbobala mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Hamare sath har dam
Dua hai Fatima ki
Kabhi akber ka matam
Kabhi asgar ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi Qasim ke gham mein
Hamare ashk jaari
Liye ghazi ka parcham
Kare pyasaon ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Tumhe milti rahegi
Dua Ummul Baneen ki
Ye matam Karbala ka
Qayamath tak rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
Eesi matam ke paiham
Hame izzath milegi
Tadap dil ki yehi hai
Azadarao ki hardam
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahein Abbas hamko
Ye hai mere sipaahi
Ye matam zindagi hai
Ye matam bandagi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera matam karenge
Hai jab tak saans baaqi
Rasheed ab Karbala mein
Karein ham milke matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Bulale apne rouze
Mere Abbas-e-ghazi
